battlecards.why_selected: Agreed to drop effective rate to 3.15% (best-in-class range) and apply pricing retroactively without service disruption.
battlecards.contract_terms: 3-year rate addendum effective 9/1/2022 with retroactive credit; tiered %-of-collections fee locked through Jan-2025; early-termination language unchanged.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Out-of-market pricing proven by third-party benchmarks and credible threat of competitive RFP or migration to collector-only offering.
supplier_strengths: Integrated EHR + RCM platform already deployed to all sites
battlecards.switching_costs: Data migration, provider retraining, and potential $9 M termination penalty before 2025.
battlecards.notes: Advantia executive team held top-to-top meeting; messaging emphasized leadership turnover and need for ‘good-faith’ partnership.

battlecards.why_selected: Delivered lowest total landed cost, accepted 60-day terms, and committed dedicated resources & formulary management for enterprise roll-out.
battlecards.contract_terms: Draft prime-vendor agreement (3-year initial term) covering inventory management KPIs, quarterly business reviews, and implementation timeline across all regions.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Promise of consolidated Heartland volume and multi-round pricing feedback in RFP drove BAFO discounts.
supplier_strengths: Willingness to support on-site staff during cut-over
supplier_weaknesses: Historically weaker service levels in Heartland region (mitigated via SLA)
battlecards.switching_costs: System set-up in McKesson Connect and product cross-reference/clinical approvals; managed via staged implementation plan.
battlecards.notes: Payment terms improved from Net-30 to Net-60, adding working-capital benefit beyond hard savings.

battlecards.why_not_selected: Pricing above McKesson BAFO and inability to meet enterprise service requirements without dual-distributor model.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Used as pricing pressure against McKesson during BAFO round.
supplier_weaknesses: Would not commit to uniform pricing across all regions
battlecards.switching_costs: Minimal once formulary converted to McKesson SKUs.
battlecards.notes: Provided extensive value-added service attachments but ultimately not enough to offset price gap.

battlecards.why_selected: Operational continuity outweighed incremental savings from Quest; LabCorp matched key price points delivering 9-10% savings.
battlecards.contract_terms: Updated pricing effective 10/15/2022; term aligned with existing service agreement (2-year remaining).
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Quest’s 19% lower proposal created credible switching threat.
supplier_strengths: Existing phlebotomist staffing, LIS interface with Athena
battlecards.switching_costs: Would require re-credentialing payers and rebuilding LIS interfaces—major disruption avoided by staying.

battlecards.why_not_selected: Change deemed operationally risky despite 19% lower pricing; incumbent able to narrow gap sufficiently.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Served as benchmark to push LabCorp downward.
supplier_strengths: Most competitive pricing across high-volume SKU list
supplier_weaknesses: Integration effort and staff retraining required
battlecards.switching_costs: New phlebotomy staffing model and interface build with Athena.
battlecards.notes: Maintain relationship as future fallback if LabCorp performance declines.

battlecards.why_not_selected: Cost-per-scan 20%+ above benchmark; inability to meet staffing flexibility requirements.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Threat of insourcing and third-party recruiter support.
battlecards.switching_costs: Short transition period to recruit staff; limited hard costs once invoice flow stopped.
battlecards.notes: Final invoices terminated Q3-22 as practices transitioned to internal techs.

battlecards.why_not_selected: Chosen only as contingency (20% utilization) since full in-house recruiting delivers lower long-term cost.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Provided ceiling pricing to validate economics of in-house option.
supplier_strengths: Rapid access to national sonographer talent pool
battlecards.notes: Framework agreement may be executed to supplement internal recruiter at ~20% workload.
